For small skincare brands and online sellers

Bangalore has many people starting something of their own: selling on Instagram, to an apartment community, or through a small studio. If that is you, buying by the kilo lets you test a product with a few dozen jars before you commit to a large run.

If you plan to fill the cream into your own jars and sell it under your own name, cosmetic labelling and licence rules apply to your business. Please check them with a qualified consultant first. We can share the product information you need for your labels.

For salons and parlours

Bangalore's weather is mild for most of the year, so one cream usually works across seasons. A thin layer of avocado night cream as the last step of a facial is the most common use. One kilo goes a long way, because each facial needs only a few grams.

How delivery works

We send orders by courier from Bhatkal to your address in Bangalore. We do not have a pickup point in the city. Share your pincode with your enquiry and we will confirm the delivery time and charge before you pay.

Night cream wholesale in Bangalore: how much should you buy?

If you are buying night cream wholesale in Bangalore for the first time, start from the number of jars you expect to sell or the facials you do in a month. One kilo fills about 100 jars of 10 g, 40 jars of 25 g or 33 jars of 30 g. A reseller testing a new product might need only a kilo or two. A busy salon will know its monthly use within a few weeks.

Not sure the cream is right for your customers? Read about our avocado cream, or order one jar from the shop before you place a bulk order.
